prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1341; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured vehicle contacted the claimant's vehicle on the driver side rear quarter panel. Both drivers remained at the scene and exchanged information. Police report requested. Initial contact made with the claimant, who reports a knee injury from the impact and is not represented by an attorney.

Entry 2: Recorded recorded statement from the insured driver. Insured states they checked the mirror and signaled before moving into the adjacent lane but did not see the claimant's vehicle in the blind spot. Insured reports no prior similar incidents on record. Photos of both vehicles reviewed; damage consistent with the reported side-contact pattern.

Entry 3: Claimant contacted by phone to discuss injury. Claimant describes swelling and limited bending in the right knee and says they were seen at an urgent care clinic the same day. Claimant has not yet provided medical records. Requested authorization for release of records and an itemized bill from the treating facility. Advised claimant of the process for submitting property damage and injury documentation.

Entry 4: Independent appraiser assigned to the claimant's vehicle. Estimate received showing repairable rear door and quarter panel damage. Rental vehicle coverage confirmed under the insured's policy for the repair period. Liability is being evaluated based on the insured's statement, the physical damage pattern, and the witness statement obtained from a passenger in the claimant's vehicle.

Entry 5: Medical records received from the urgent care clinic and reviewed. Diagnosis noted as a knee sprain with soreness, with follow-up recommended with an orthopedic provider if symptoms persist. Claimant's injury file updated. Liability assessment ongoing pending review of the police report. Next step is to contact the claimant for an update on treatment progress and to confirm the repair shop has been selected.
